**Finding submitted: ASSIGN — deviation (fallback cure proposed).**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** § 16.2 Assignment (p0281, p0284), § 16.5 Sale or Merger (p0290), § 16.18 (p0327), Loan Agreement § 16 (p1578), confidentiality § 8 (p1494), Appendix A MS provisions (p1346). No change-of-control clause exists anywhere.
- **Why it fails fallback:** § 16.2 blanket-bars IBM assignment without MSL approval — no affiliate/successor carve-out, no reasonableness standard on IBM's side (the "not unreasonably withheld" language runs only to MSL's Related Company assignments). § 16.5 only obliges MSL to notify and procure successor assumption, giving IBM no assignment right.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace in p0281 adding a mutual successor-assignment right on written notice and a reasonableness standard on consent for other assignments, preserving MSL's Related Company consent sentence verbatim and dropping only the now-redundant, contradictory MSL-only bar.
- **Not flagged:** MSL-only restrictions in the Loan Agreement and confidentiality terms benefit us; the absent change-of-control trigger needed no added language at the fallback level.
